localChanges: With Civilization's sound imported, your civilization's theme now plays as a new game begins, and a rival's plays when they ask to speak with you and through the talks (#126).

Your theme also plays when you capture a city, build a Wonder or learn an advance, and the capturer's when you lose a city. Prepare for war plays when a treaty is cancelled or war is declared, and Civ1's tunes play for We Love the King Day, civil disorder, famine, a finished build, a nuclear attack, and winning or losing the game.
The 12 civilizations Civ1 has no theme for borrow one of its themes for now (closes #800).

log: feat: each civilization's national theme in Civ1's music, as a nationalTheme attribute (civ-clone/web-renderer#800)
feat: each civilization borrows a Civ1 civilization's national theme until it has its own (civ-clone/web-renderer#800)
